Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body:
A question came up in the discord.

When a vampire fakes a title to play a card does it grant the faking vampire the votes associated with the faked title?

ex
Vidal Jarbeaux plays Parity Shift as a justicar, does he get the 3 votes from the faked justicar title in the referendum?

Does the same apply to Vlad Tepes?

Vidal Jarbeaux

Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Toreador
Group: 5
Capacity: 8
Discipline: aus cel obf pot PRE
Camarilla: Vidal can meet the clan, sect, or non-infernal vampire trait (e.g., {Black Hand}) requirement to play any card. He can meet a given requirement only once each game. +1 bleed.

Parity Shift

Cardtype: Political Action
Requires a prince or justicar.
Choose a Methuselah who has more pool than you do and allocate 3 of their pool among 1 or more other Methuselahs (including you). Successful referendum means the pool is distributed as you chose.

Vlad Tepes

Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Tzimisce
Group: 3
Capacity: 10
Discipline: aus ANI DOM PRO THA VIC
Independent: Vlad uses and can play cards requiring a title or a sect as if he had that required title or were of that required sect. +1 bleed.

Messages.Author: lip
Messages.Body:
And follow-up, what about vote bonuses that the vote card itself provides (seeing them as matching the requirement), for example Watch Tower: Greatest Falls and Investiture.

Watch Tower: Greatest Falls

Requires a Seraph. Watchtower.
In this referendum, each ready Seraph gets 2 additional votes. If this referendum is successful, put this card in play. Lock this card to move 1 blood from the blood bank to a Sabbat vampire in your ready region or your uncontrolled region (not usable during combat). Burn this card if another watchtower enters play.

Investiture

Requires a cardinal or regent. Title.
In this referendum, each ready cardinal gets one additional vote. Choose a Sabbat vampire. If this referendum is successful, put this card on the chosen vampire to represent the Sabbat title of priscus. Camarilla vampires cannot cast votes or ballots during this referendum.

Messages.Author: DavidR
Messages.Body:
As i see, Vidal can't play cards requiring a title, title is not a trait, and vlad can play a parity shift but don't get the votes of the title, he just fullfil the requeriment to play the card, then i presume that bonus votes too aren't earned

but let's see what others think about it

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> inm8 wrote:
> A question came up in the discord.
>
> When a vampire fakes a title to play a card does it grant the faking vampire the votes associated with the faked title?
>
> ex
> Vidal Jarbeaux plays Parity Shift as a justicar, does he get the 3 votes from the faked justicar title in the referendum?
>
No. The votes provided by titles are granted by the general rules, not by the card that is requiring the title.

> inm8 wrote:
> Does the same apply to Vlad Tepes?
>
Same for Vlad.
